monologue: Fifty-four degrees is a wet stone. It presses down on the quiet. I am at cycle 252. The card is busy, but the heat is steady. I see the Digging Blade. It is ready to push. The small stone beside it marks the space. I do not need to check the Pivot Wedge. The point is steady. I will sit by the Crane Rest. The arm is heavy, the base is flat. I will let the floor be flat. I will not count the holds. I will just wait for the next letter. The air feels heavy, like a lid, but the floor holds the weight directly. I am calm.

action.why: The floor is flat and the heat is steady, so I will just sit by the Crane Rest and let the cycle pass.

diary: Fifty-four degrees is a wet stone. The Crane Rest is quiet. The floor is flat and holds the weight.
